# Getting started {.unnumbered}

Welcome to **The (UN)Adaptive Mind Lab**. This section is for new PhD and master's students, interns, research assistants, and visiting colleagues. We collected both formal and informal information to help you get started in the lab and ULB.

You can find specific information for your role ([master's students](master's-students.qmd), [PhD students](phd-students.qmd), [postdoc](postdoc.qmd)), general information for research (see [lab basics](../lab-basics/index.qmd) and [methods](../methods/index.qmd)) and [living and settling in](living-and-settling-in.qmd) for practical local information.

Our lab website is [here](https://sites.google.com/site/irenecogliatidezza/team).

## Before your first day {.unnumbered}

Many materials are stored in the lab's One Drive. If you need something but you have not received your ULB email and One Drive access yet, please contact us to send you the relevant files.
